verdict.rationale: Routing is a fair axis for a UI framework's ecosystem, but the evidence shows no first-party React routing library. The docs only recommend third-party frameworks such as Next.js or React Router for building full apps. That is adjacent ecosystem guidance, not an official routing library shipped by React.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party routing library that integrates seamlessly with the framework

citations.quote: To build an entire app with React, we recommend a full-stack React framework like Next.js or React Router.
